Interface Formatters.TableFormatterFactory

Enclosing interface:
Formatters
public static interface Formatters.TableFormatterFactory
Interface of a component that provides factory methods for various table formatters. A TableFormatter object is used to format objects of certain types, e.g. Customer, Article or Order as a table.
